case_results.independent_oracle: Fixture pins the literal worktree UUIDs, repository identity, HEAD and folder name, then compares stored generation, snapshot digest and scope digest directly.
The synthetic candidates have known package paths and byte ranges; expected ambiguity and selected identity are asserted from those literals.
Expected declaration kinds, lexical scopes and distinct IDs are specified from the inline Go source and validated against byte slices.
The inline generic receiver and two closure parameters have fixed expected names, kinds, scopes and raw-source ranges.
The captured fixture contains field reads, assignments and pointer writes; independently expected relation kinds require zero READS/WRITES until alias/data-flow proof exists.
case_results.limitation: The negative alias oracle is tested; positive READS/WRITES relations for a proven alias are not implemented or claimed.

case_results.independent_oracle: The fixture constructs direct-call and function-value facts separately and compares their exact relation kinds and identities.
Inline Reader interface and two concrete implementations define the independent expected result: one CALLS_INTERFACE, two MAY_DISPATCH_TO, and zero arbitrary direct targets at each callsite.
Expected relation kinds and the unresolved label are declared in the test and compared to source-bound facts.

Captured profile fixtures independently assert selected source files for Linux/amd64, Linux/arm64 and Windows/amd64, distinguish tagged from untagged builds, require distinct ProfileIDs for each changed GOOS/GOARCH/tag/CGO input, and require the explicit partial diagnostic while CGO is unsupported.
Production, internal-test and external-test source bytes are written inline; expected occurrence count, variants and symbol IDs are explicit constants.
Fixture paths and Git boundary metadata are created by the test; expected inventory entries and skipped boundaries are checked directly.
case_results.limitation: Generated/vendor/sparse/submodule metadata is checked on synthetic Git fixtures; no third-party repository corpus is included.

case_results.independent_oracle: A temporary module missing one dependency must return syntax-only partial status and an explicit diagnostic without installing dependencies.
The fixture adds one known untracked path after capture; the expected membership digest and stale result are independently calculated.
Before and after path sets and hashes are literal fixture inputs; test requires full rebuild and forbids fuzzy identity reuse.
The test changes bytes while preserving size and mtime; the expected SHA-256 is computed from fixture bytes with the standard library.
Git refs and HEAD state are constructed in a temporary repository; expected unborn/detached states are constants, not inferred from the indexer.
The module/config/dependency vectors are explicit fixture inputs; expected consumer invalidation and rebuild mode are asserted from the changed inputs.
A fixed-seed mutation sequence is applied to source fixtures; normalized full and incremental fact sets are compared and repeated replay bytes must match.
Injected commit and batch failures are checked against direct SQL reads of state, active pointer and foreign-key integrity.
Each reader compares literal generation markers and active pointer values within one SQLite read snapshot during repeated writes.
Independent OS processes coordinate by pipe markers; fixture A holds its writer while fixture B must publish and A's reader remains pinned.
A child process owns the OS lock; parent observes contention before child exit and reacquisition after the kernel releases ownership.
A deterministic fake workspace changes membership on every read; expected bounded retry count and UNKNOWN outcome are fixed in the test.
Outside-root sentinel bytes are fixed; every race result is checked against allowed-root content and explicit denial.
case_results.limitation: UNC, ADS, invalid UTF-8 and other operating systems are not executed by the Windows and Ubuntu CI pair.

case_results.independent_oracle: Unique synthetic secret markers are searched directly in persisted bytes, FTS rows, logs and MCP payloads; expected zero matches are literal.
The malicious repository text and fsmonitor command marker are synthetic constants; a marker file or child process is forbidden after capture.
Expected byte offsets are computed from the inline Vietnamese/Lao/emoji/CRLF bytes; roundtrip and invalid UTF-8 boundaries are asserted.
Fixture caps are literal byte counts; response JSON validity, required evidence, and both serialized delivery byte totals are independently checked.
Known graph adjacency and limit values are hand-authored; expected pending/unknown states and continuation cursor progress are checked exactly.
The test starts with a known signer, scope, request and expiry; each tampered identity and expired token has a fixed expected error.
Fixture evidence IDs and page cursor are fixed; repeated page requests must advance over the same pinned set without skipping unrequested items.
case_results.limitation: AI host session creation and real context compaction are outside this engine process and are not exercised here.

case_results.independent_oracle: Every proposed edit is compared to captured bytes and exact before/after hashes; the preview must enumerate all expected paths and ranges.
Exported field and JSON tag source ranges are literal; warnings preserve serialization keys and forbidden string/tag edits are rejected.
Synthetic server messages use fixed method names and payloads; outbound client edit/command events must remain absent and unsupported requests must be rejected.
A controlled fake transport records request IDs, cancellation and closure; test asserts bounded completion after cancellation.
case_results.limitation: The settling checks are bounded test fixtures; long-duration production LSP/MCP soak is not run.

case_results.independent_oracle: Faults are injected at staging and commit boundaries; direct SQLite queries require old active generation and intact source fixtures afterward.
case_results.limitation: Disk-full and real permission-denied filesystem conditions are not induced on the host volume.

case_results.independent_oracle: The fixture database bytes are hashed before and after opening with a future schema version; migration failure preserves the original digest.
Fixture foreign keys, active pointer and blob references are authored independently; direct SQL checks verify retained and deleted rows after GC.
Raw malformed, duplicate-member and unknown-field JSON byte strings have explicit expected validator errors and response envelope shapes.
The CLI test compares exact registered command help against the checked-in reference; it does not infer a host configuration from product output.
case_results.limitation: A real Codex installation/version roundtrip and non-overwrite check require a supported host and are NOT_RUN.

case_results.independent_oracle: The complete synthetic canary tree is independently hashed before and after every public route; bytes, paths and configuration must match.
The fixture database has known schema indexes; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN rows are compared to expected named indexes and bounded fixture sizes.
The specification text is mutated in an isolated in-memory copy; expected duplicate, dependency and dangling-ID diagnostics are literal assertions.
case_results.limitation: Static tracker validation is tested; simultaneous independent editor processes are not stress-tested by this case.

case_results.independent_oracle: The benchmark pins target and analyzer revisions through Git and reports measured source bytes, inventory files, symbols and allocations.
case_results.limitation: This single-run local benchmark does not produce warm/cold cache or AI cached-token comparisons, and is not a performance baseline.

case_results.independent_oracle: The fixture labels lexical and unknown evidence explicitly; expected relationship kinds and gaps are hand-authored and must not become semantic edges.
The test injects a fake GOPROXY and GOSUMDB server with a request counter, poisoned GOFLAGS and GOPACKAGESDRIVER; zero proxy requests and source-hash rejection are expected.
A local HTTP proxy counter provides the independent network-attempt oracle; captured source hashes are independently computed from test fixture bytes.
case_results.limitation: The fixture proves no request reached its local proxy under the poisoned environment; host-wide packet capture and unrelated external destinations are not measured.

case_results.independent_oracle: Unique secret sentinels and oversized diagnostic values are supplied by the test; emitted JSONL bytes must match the closed allowlist and contain no sentinel.
Hand-built module/package/reference graph has exact expected grouped counts, direction, evidence and expansion members.
Fixture partitions, edges, export digests and membership are literal; selective closure and full fallback are compared to hand-calculated expected sets.
The stored scope vector and epoch are fixed fixture values; source and membership mutations must return stale/unknown before edit eligibility.
A spec-only checkout contains assigned but absent code; intended facts and observed files are independently declared, with no synthesized call edges.
The synthetic filesystem walker computes file count, source bytes and SHA-256 separately from inventory and manifest outputs; acceptance compares exact totals and bounded metrics.
case_results.limitation: The runnable matrix defaults to controlled S/combined. It makes no M/L/XL or 1,000,000-file/32-GiB product-support claim; separate T053 measurements remain scoped to their recorded revision.

case_results.independent_oracle: Target checkout and analyzer source revisions are resolved directly with Git; expected identity and source facts are checked independently of the binary's revision label.
Tests mutate isolated copies of the canonical spec/docs sources and require missing, duplicate/version-drift and line-ending/hash-only changes to fail without replacing source.
The validator receives an altered in-memory task assignment and a docs/source status mutation; exact status and dependency errors are asserted.
case_results.limitation: The current implement assignment and prompt sources are validated; no separate docs-only task execution is launched.

case_results.independent_oracle: An isolated candidate commit/SPEC diff changes a protected gate or design contract; validator must reject the changed scope while ordinary local helpers remain allowed.
case_results.limitation: The fixture enforces tracked task/contract boundaries; it does not implement an external dependency approval service.

case_results.independent_oracle: Fake commands record argv and side effects; shell wrappers, unapproved environment and download-like commands must be rejected before child execution.
Fake volume observations and integer budgets include exact boundary, negative and overflow values; expected admit/block decisions are literal.
Multiple logical destinations share one synthetic volume and reservation ID; expected unique required bytes are calculated from fixture constants.
Two independent synthetic destinations and writer markers are counted before launch; the denied command must leave its side-effect marker absent.
case_results.limitation: The fixtures cover isolated admission and same-resource serialization; unknown external writers are represented as uncertainty, not observed host workloads.

case_results.independent_oracle: Fresh run-owned synthetic Git/SQLite trees have explicit identity manifests; teardown is allowed only after writer settlement and retained evidence checks.
The fixture replaces a registered child and creates linked/common Git paths; expected refusal is asserted from canonical identities and filesystem links.
An exited-owner journal and synthetic leftover bytes are measured directly; dry-run output is checked against pre/post SQLite rows and source hashes.
case_results.limitation: Fresh fixture teardown is exercised; an uncatchable host crash and legacy user leftovers are reported as protected and are not cleaned.

case_results.independent_oracle: Run an incomplete-scope test on an immutable Git archive, remove exactly the scope-completeness guard in the copy, and require baseline PASS plus mutant FAIL; no expected result is generated from engine output.
case_results.limitation: The selected mutation targets one critical cache freshness invariant; this is not a repository-wide mutation score.

case_results.independent_oracle: Synthetic CI observations distinguish configured checks, exact-SHA successful execution, missing/stale/skipped checks and required unknown evidence.
case_results.limitation: Local contract tests do not prove branch protection, human review, production readiness or deployment enforcement.

case_results.independent_oracle: A synthetic three-level module graph and live/shared references are queried before and after GC; delete events must follow explicit leaf-before-parent order.
Failure injection fires at a fixed delete stage; independent row counts, retired state and profile/record fixtures must equal their before snapshot.
A deliberately corrupt cycle is inserted in fixture SQL; publish/GC must fail closed and dry-run must leave all queried table hashes unchanged.
